Goal: A TypeScript tic tac toe game for the browser: a clickable 3x3 board in the DOM, a computer opponent that uses minimax so it never loses, a score counter, and a restart button.

Write the skeleton of the whole game as one TypeScript code block: types, top-level variables with their types, and every function with its full typed signature and a one-line comment above it saying what it does. Every function body must be only `// TODO`. Include the code at the bottom that sets up the page and starts the game.

// @types/brightleaf-notes
// @types/brightleaf-boards

// @types/brightleaf-pulse

// Board
type Board = {
  row1: string;
  row2: string;
  row3: string;
};

// Player
type Player = {
  name: string;
  symbol: string;
};

// Score
type Score = {
  player1: number;
  player2: number;
  total: number;
};

// Game
type Game = {
  board: Board;
  player1: Player;
  player2: Player;
  score: Score;
};

// Game state
type GameState = {
  game: Game;
  isGameRunning: boolean;
  isGameOver: boolean;
};

// Functions
function initBoard(): void {
  // Initialize board
  const board = [
    [' ', ' ', ' '],
    [' ', ' ', ' '],
    [' ', ' ', ' '],
  ];
  const boardElement = document.getElementById('board');
  boardElement.innerHTML = board.map(row => row.join('')).join('');
}

function startGame(): void {
  // Initialize game state
  const game = {
    board: board,
    player1: {
      name: 'Player 1',
      symbol: 'X',
    },
    player2: {
      name: 'Player 2',
      symbol: 'O',
    },
    score: {
      player1: 0,
      player2: 0,
      total: 0,
    },
    isGameRunning: true,
    isGameOver: false,
  };

  // Start game
  game.board = board;
  game.player1.symbol = 'X';
  game.player2.symbol = 'O';
  game.score.total = 0;
  initBoard();
  startGameLoop(game);
}

function startGameLoop(game: GameState): void {
  // Game loop
  while (game.isGameRunning) {
    const move = getMove(game);
    if (move) {
      // Update board
      updateBoard(game.board, move);
      // Update score
      updateScore(game.score);
      // Check if game is over
      checkGameOver(game);
      // Update game state
      game.isGameRunning = true;
    }
  }
}

function getMove(game: GameState): string | null {
  // Get move from user or computer
  const move = prompt("Enter your move (X/O):");
  return move;
}

function updateBoard(board: Board, move: string): void {
  // Update board
  board[move[0]][move[1]] = move;
  // Re-render board
  initBoard();
}

function updateScore(score: Score): void {
  // Update score
  score.player1 += 1;
  score.player2 += 1;
  score.total += 1;
}

function checkGameOver(game: GameState): void {
  // Check if game is over
  if (game.isGameOver) {
    alert("Game Over!");
    restartGame();
  }
}

function restartGame(): void {
  // Restart game
  const game = {
    board: board,
    player1: {
      name: 'Player 1',
      symbol: 'X',
    },
    player2: {
      name: 'Player 2',
      symbol: 'O',
    },
    score: {
      player1: 0,
      player2: 0,
      total: 0,
    },
    isGameRunning: true,
    isGameOver: false,
  };
  initBoard();
  startGameLoop(game);
}

// Game state
type GameState = {
  game: Game;
  isGameRunning: boolean;
  isGameOver: boolean;
};

// Initialize the game
initBoard();
startGame();

// Sets up the page and starts the game
function setupGame(): void {
  // Add board element
  const boardElement = document.getElementById('board');
  if (!boardElement) {
    boardElement = document.createElement('div');
    boardElement.className = 'board';
    boardElement.id = 'board';
    boardElement.innerHTML = "  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  ";
    document.body.appendChild(boardElement);
  }

  // Add game element
  const gameElement = document.getElementById('game');
  if (!gameElement) {
    gameElement = document.createElement('div');
    gameElement.className = 'game';
    gameElement.innerHTML = "  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  ";
    gameElement.id = 'game';
    document.body.appendChild(gameElement);
  }

  // Add restart button
  const restartButton = document.createElement('button');
  restartButton.textContent = 'Restart';
  gameElement.appendChild(restartButton);

  // Initialize game state
  const game = {
    board: [
      [' ', ' ', ' '],
      [' ', ' ', ' '],
      [' ', ' ', ' '],
    ],
    player1: {
      name: 'Player 1',
      symbol: 'X',
    },
    player2: {

    },
    score: {
      player1: 0,
      player2: 0,
      total: 0,
    },
    isGameRunning: true,
    isGameOver: false,
  };

  initBoard();
  startGameLoop(game);
}

setupGame();

function startGameLoop(game: GameState): void {
  // Initialize the board and update the score
  initBoard();
  updateScore(game.score);
  
  // Start the game loop
  while (game.isGameRunning) {
    // Handle the move
    const move = getMove(game);
    
    // Update the board and score
    updateBoard(game.board, move);
    updateScore(game.score);
    
    // Check if the game is over
    checkGameOver(game);
    
    // Restart the game if it's over
    if (game.isGameOver) {
      restartGame();
    }
  }
}

function checkGameOver(game: GameState): void {
  // Check rows, columns, and diagonals for a win
  if (game.board.row1 === game.board.row2 && game.board.row1 === game.board.row3) {
    game.isGameOver = true;
  } else if (game.board.row2 === game.board.row3 && game.board.row2 === game.board.row1) {
    game.isGameOver = true;
  } else if (game.board.row1 === game.board.row2 && game.board.row1 === game.board.row3) {
    game.isGameOver = true;
  } else if (game.board.row3 === game.board.row2 && game.board.row3 === game.board.row1) {
    game.isGameOver = true;
  } else if (game.board.row1 === game.board.row2 && game.board.row1 === game.board.row3) {
    game.isGameOver = true;
  } else if (game.board.row2 === game.board.row3 && game.board.row2 === game.board.row1) {
    game.isGameOver = true;
  } else if (game.board.row1 === game.board.row2 && game.board.row1 === game.board.row3) {
    game.isGameOver = true;
  } else if (game.board.row2 === game.board.row3 && game.board.row2 === game.board.row1) {
    game.isGameOver = true;
  }
}
